Lets a macro put a dialog on screen, and open other apps, while you are looking at something else. Android blocks both from a background app without it.
Lets Ottomatic see notifications from other apps, so a macro can react to one.
Lets a macro turn Do Not Disturb on and off, and switch the ringer to silent.
Lets Ottomatic see volume and power button presses. It never reads screen content.
Keeps Android from stopping the engine in the background. Without it, macros may not re-arm after a reboot and time-based triggers can be delayed.
Lets a schedule fire, and a wait end, at the minute you asked for. Without it Android is free to batch it with other work, so it may run late.
Lets a macro change screen brightness, screen timeout and auto-rotate.
Lets a macro run when you hold an NFC tag to the back of your phone. Ottomatic cannot switch NFC on for you, and tags are only read while the screen is on and unlocked.
Lets a macro find and read the pictures on your phone, and lets it start when a new one is saved. Without this, every photo node does nothing.
Lets a macro change, move or delete a photo on older versions of Android. From Android 10 onwards there is nothing to grant here: Android asks you to confirm each change instead.
Lets a macro read where a photo was taken. Without it, Android hides the location in photos other apps saved, and a macro is told the photo has none.

Lets a macro change, move or delete photos without asking you to confirm each one. Optional: without it everything still works, Android just asks you every time, which needs you to be holding the phone.
Lets Ottomatic keep its engine running while your macros are armed.
Lets Ottomatic use device administrator features.
Lets a geofence know when you arrive somewhere or leave it.
A rougher fix, used when precise location is not available.
Lets a geofence keep working while Ottomatic is closed — which is the only time it is any use. Granted by choosing \"Allow all the time\".
Lets a macro run when a text arrives, and read who it is from and what it says.
Lets a macro send a text on your behalf.
Lets a macro place a call without you confirming it.
Lets a macro look up the number of a contact you chose. Choosing one needs nothing; dialling it later does.

Lets a macro read your appointments, and lets you pick a calendar when setting one up. Unlike contacts, there is no system picker to lean on, so this is needed before a calendar node can show you anything.
Lets a macro create, change and delete appointments. Reading them is a separate switch above.
Lets Ottomatic show a notification — both the ones a macro posts and the one that tells you the engine failed to start after a reboot.
Lets a macro turn Bluetooth on and off.
Used by a node on one of your macros.
Ottomatic needs accessibility access to see button presses. It never reads screen content. If the switch is greyed out, open App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings first.
Ottomatic needs notification access to see notifications from other apps.
Ottomatic needs Do Not Disturb access to change your ringer mode.
Ottomatic needs permission to draw over other apps so this dialog can reach you while you are somewhere else on your phone. Without it the node cancels instead of asking.

This trigger needs NFC switched on, which is a system-wide setting rather than something Ottomatic can grant itself. Tags are also only read while the screen is on and unlocked — a tap will not reach a phone asleep in your pocket.

Ottomatic needs permission to set exact alarms so this wait ends at the minute you asked for. Without it the wait still happens, but Android batches the wake-up with other work and it can be minutes late.
Ottomatic needs calendar access to read your appointments. Without it this node reads nothing at all, and the calendar chooser above has nothing to offer.
Ottomatic needs permission to change your calendar so this node can create, edit or delete an appointment. Reading appointments is a separate grant.
Ottomatic needs access to your photos so this node can find and read them. Choosing a picture yourself does not need it; looking for one while the macro runs does.
Ottomatic needs permission to change your photos so this node can rewrite one. On Android 10 and newer this grant does nothing and Android asks you to confirm each change instead.
Ottomatic needs permission to read where a photo was taken, or this node reports every picture as having no location. Photos you took yourself are unaffected.
Ottomatic can change photos without asking you each time. This is optional: without it the node still works, but Android puts a confirmation on screen, so it cannot run unattended.

Ottomatic needs permission to draw over other apps so it can put Android’s confirmation on screen while the macro runs in the background. Without it, changing a photo another app saved fails when you are not in Ottomatic.

Ottomatic needs permission to draw over other apps so it can open one while you are somewhere else on your phone. Android blocks a background app from opening another, and without this the node does nothing and says so in the console.
